en: Playing a card from this slot triggers the charge payload (roman numeral = required count). Lasts for the listed turns.

zh_CN: 同一回合内按出牌队列统计各属性的不同角色数（出牌队列里的所有卡都计入，含支援/弱化等非输出卡）：2 名 +25%，3 名 +50%，4 名 +100%。加成只作用于物理/魔法/治疗卡，多属性卡取最高档。
en: Per turn the queue is tallied per element by distinct characters (every queued card counts, support and debuff cards included): 2 characters +25%, 3 +50%, 4 +100%. The bonus only applies to physical, magic and healing cards, and a multi-element card takes its best element.

zh_CN: 分配输入数额到选中槽位
从选中槽位扣除输入数额
每回合卡牌结算完成后自动执行一次：按（回合数-1）％队伍人数决定出手角色；对该角色的物攻与魔攻取较高者减目标对应防御后对全部敌人造成伤害。普攻次数加成会让归属角色连续执行多次，[url=kw:follow_up]追打[/url]者每次都会参与。不吃[url=kw:chain]连携[/url]也不触发手牌槽效果。
en: Runs once per turn after all cards resolve. The acting character rotates by (turn - 1) % party size and strikes every enemy with the higher of physical or magic attack minus the matching defense. Extra normal attack count makes the acting character repeat it, and follow-up holders join each repetition. Ignores chain and slot effects.

zh_CN: 全队共享的队列资源：满 7 个即刻自动触发；出牌阶段球数 ≥3 时可主动触发（可重复）。触发会清空队列并逐球结算，每个球以「获得它时的角色」为产球者。每回合结束固定产出 1 个[url=kw:orb_element]属性球[/url]加 1 个物理或魔法球。
en: A team-shared queue. Reaching the cap of 7 triggers it automatically and during your turn you may trigger it manually at 3 or more orbs (repeatable). Triggering clears the queue and resolves each orb in order using the producer captured when it was granted. Each turn end grants 1 element orb plus 1 physical or magic orb.

zh_CN: 红蓝绿黄四种[url=kw:orb]充能球[/url]中的元素球：单球伤害 =（每球固定值 + 产球者攻击力 × 加成比例）×（1 + 产球者增伤 + 目标受伤增加）；增伤与受伤增加一律同桶加算、不吃连携，也不吃目标的物理与魔法防御。所用攻击力按球类型取物攻、魔攻或两者较高者。
en: Four elemental orbs (red / blue / green / yellow). Per-orb damage = (flat value + producer attack × scale) × (1 + producer damage bonuses + target damage-taken scale); all damage bonuses share one additive bucket, and orbs ignore chain as well as both physical and magic defense. The attack stat used depends on the orb type.

zh_CN: 整支队伍共用一本血量账本：任何角色受到的伤害都从账本扣除；账本归零即整队失败（同归于尽判负）。治疗同样只回账本。
en: The party shares a single HP ledger. Damage to any character is deducted from it and the run is lost when it hits zero. Healing only refills the ledger.

zh_CN: 全队共享的解锁资源：用于解锁角色被动（阈值即成本）。重复获得同一角色会转化为潜能（见 [url=kw:character_passive]角色被动[/url]）——该角色已在某个槽位时直充那个槽位，否则进入团队池（表决模式下消费需提议通过）。
en: A team-shared unlock resource used to unlock character passives (the threshold is the cost). Duplicate characters convert into potential: credited to that slot when the character already holds it and to the team pool otherwise (in vote mode spending requires a passed proposal).

zh_CN: 角色定义里声明的被动：开战时按潜能档位由低到高挂载，之后完全由 buff 钩子驱动（回合开始、释放主动技、阶层开始等）。未解锁的被动不生效。
en: Passives declared on the character definition. They are attached at battle start in ascending potential order and driven entirely by buff hooks (turn start / active skill cast / wave start and so on). Locked passives do nothing.

zh_CN: 持有者在不是本回合[url=kw:normal_attack]普通攻击[/url]归属角色时，仍以标明的百分比攻击力参与该次普攻（目标与公式同普攻）。多个追打效果同时存在时只取最高值；归属角色自己持有追打不会重复出手。
en: When the holder is not this turn's normal attacker, they still join that normal attack at the listed percentage of their attack power (same targets and formula). Only the highest follow-up value applies, and the acting character never strikes twice.

zh_CN: 被封印的角色无法标记卡牌与释放主动技，已有标记会被清空并退还费用，并视作本回合已行动；封印只挡出牌，不影响普通攻击与被动的触发。免疫封印的角色完全不受该效果影响。
en: A sealed character cannot mark cards or cast the active skill: existing marks are cleared with their cost refunded and the character counts as having acted this turn. Sealing only blocks card play; normal attacks and passives still happen. Characters immune to seal ignore the effect entirely.

zh_CN: 挂在手牌槽上的减益：从该槽打出卡牌时，把相邻的手牌槽里的牌吹散（弃置）。相邻槽按「先左后右、由近及远」选取，数量由暴风等级决定（暴风 I = 1 个）。被吹散的是未入队的牌，已标记确认的牌不受影响；免疫暴风的角色手牌不会被吹散。
en: [url=kw:hand_slot_damage]Hand slot[/url] debuff: playing a card from this slot blows away the cards in neighbouring slots (they are discarded). Neighbours are picked left-first then right, nearest first, up to the storm's level (Storm I = 1 slot). Only unqueued cards are blown away, and a character immune to storms keeps their hand.

zh_CN: 敌人每次轮到行动时会先检查行动计数：计数大于 1 时本回合只把计数减 1、不行动，计数为 1 时正常行动。因此把敌人的行动计数设为 2 就等于把它的这次行动推迟到下个回合；敌人的技能与普攻都受此约束。
en: Each time an enemy's turn comes up its action count is checked first: above 1 it only decreases by one and the enemy does nothing that turn, at 1 the enemy acts normally. Setting an enemy's action count to 2 therefore pushes its action to the next turn. Both enemy skills and normal attacks are gated this way.

zh_CN: 队伍级的持续场地效果，同一队伍同时只存在 1 个：新领域展开会顶替旧领域。领域可以带持续回合数（如「展开 2 回合」），到期自动收起；也可以不带时长，直到被下一个领域顶替。
en: A team-wide persistent field effect. Only one domain can be active per team: opening a new one replaces the old. A domain may declare a duration in turns (for example "lasts 2 turns") and folds itself away when it expires, or stay until replaced.
